aboutGame.title: What is NBA Heroes?
paragraphs: NBA Heroes is a Roblox basketball game that turns real-world superstars into comic-style heroes with active skills, passive boosts, and game-breaking ultimates. Matches blend authentic 3v3 and 5v5 basketball with arcade shot timing, stamina management, and a Hero Gauge that powers signature moves.

Players build a roster from archetypes such as Kinetic Marksman, Force-Multiplier Titan, Velocity Speedster, and Shadow Sentinel, then spend attribute points across Finishing, Shooting, Playmaking, Defense/Rebounding, and Physicals. Our wiki breaks down hero abilities, builds, codes, tier rankings, and progression so you can climb the ranked ladder.

modules.name: NBA Heroes Codes
modules.description: Track the latest NBA Heroes codes, reward drops, and redemption steps, and learn which free packs and boosts are worth claiming first.

highlights.label: NO-ACTIVE
highlights.detail: There are no active NBA Heroes codes right now; new reward drops usually arrive with weekly updates.

highlights.label: REDEEM-STEPS
highlights.detail: Open the in-game Settings menu, find the Codes or Promo Code box, paste the code, then press Redeem.

highlights.label: CASE-SENSITIVE
highlights.detail: NBA Heroes codes are case-sensitive, so copy the string exactly and remove any trailing spaces.

highlights.label: REWARD-TYPES
highlights.detail: Typical rewards include player packs, skill badges, and attribute training boosts for your roster.

modules.name: NBA Heroes Beginner Guide
modules.description: A step-by-step NBA Heroes beginner guide covering hero archetypes, core attributes, shot timing, and how to win your first matches.

highlights.detail: Pick a balanced starting hero and learn the five core attributes: Finishing, Shooting, Playmaking, Defense/Rebounding, and Physicals.
Practice the shot meter and release at the apex of the jump to hit the green window and build Hero Gauge.
Manage stamina, because sprinting drains the gauge and shrinks your green release window late in possessions.
Build lineup synergy with complementary archetypes instead of stacking five pure scorers.
Complete daily challenge drills and early matches to earn XP and unlock your first skill slots.

modules.name: NBA Heroes Controls Guide
modules.description: Learn NBA Heroes controls for shooting, dribbling, passing, blocking, and hustle plays with the input timing for each move.

highlights.label: SHOOT
highlights.detail: Hold and release the shot button or stick at the apex of the jump to hit the green window.

highlights.label: CROSSOVER
highlights.detail: Flick the right stick during a drive to break your defender's balance and create open space.

highlights.label: BLOCK
highlights.detail: Time the block button with directional up as the ball leaves the shooter's hands to swat or deflect it.

highlights.label: PASS
highlights.detail: Use the pass plus modifier button to fire a bounce dish past long wingspans in a crowded lane.

highlights.label: HUSTLE
highlights.detail: Tap sprint plus hustle on a loose ball to win the dive frame and secure possession.

modules.name: NBA Heroes Gameplay Tips
modules.description: Win more NBA Heroes matches with proven tips for shot selection, defensive coverages, stamina pacing, and late-game timeouts.

highlights.label: Spacing
highlights.detail: Run pick-and-roll and step-back actions to create open looks instead of forcing contested shots.

highlights.label: Defense
highlights.detail: Switch between drop coverage, switch-all, and traps to counter the opponent's favorite plays.

highlights.label: Stamina
highlights.detail: Avoid constant sprinting so your green release window stays wide in the fourth quarter.

highlights.label: Rotation
highlights.detail: Rotate bench players early to keep your primary ball handler fresh for clutch possessions.

highlights.label: Timeouts
highlights.detail: Call tactical timeouts to stop an opponent's scoring run and reset your lineup's stamina.

modules.name: NBA Heroes Updates
modules.description: Follow NBA Heroes update notes covering balance changes, new heroes, event modes, and the meta shifts that matter most.

highlights.label: Contest
highlights.detail: Adjusted perimeter closeout hitboxes reduce uncontested threes and reward good footwork.

highlights.label: Stamina
highlights.detail: Turbo sprinting drains more stamina, discouraging constant baseline-to-baseline runs.

highlights.label: Cooldowns
highlights.detail: Ultimate hero abilities gained an 8% cooldown extension for more tactical late-game use.

highlights.label: Badges
highlights.detail: Reworked badge chemistry multipliers encourage diverse lineups over powerhouse duos.

highlights.label: Turnovers
highlights.detail: Blind cross-court passes carry a higher interception risk, emphasizing deliberate ball movement.

faq.title: NBA Heroes FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about NBA Heroes codes, heroes, and progression.

items.question: What is NBA Heroes?
items.answer: NBA Heroes is a Roblox basketball game that mixes 3v3 and 5v5 matches with hero abilities, letting NBA-inspired characters use signature skills powered by the Hero Gauge.

items.question: Are there any working NBA Heroes codes?
items.answer: There are no active NBA Heroes codes right now, but new reward drops usually arrive with weekly updates, so check the codes page regularly.

items.question: Which hero should beginners pick in NBA Heroes?
items.answer: Start with a balanced Hybrid Apex hero in NBA Heroes, learn the shot meter and stamina system, then branch into a Kinetic Marksman or a Force-Multiplier Titan.

items.question: How do you level up fast in NBA Heroes?
items.answer: Complete daily challenge drills, win ranked PvP matches, and finish limited event quests to earn NBA Heroes XP and raise your roster's attribute ceilings.

items.question: Is NBA Heroes free to play?
items.answer: Yes, NBA Heroes is free to play on Roblox, and optional purchases speed up progression without blocking access to matches, heroes, or codes.

items.question: How often does NBA Heroes get updated?
items.answer: NBA Heroes receives weekly updates that add new heroes, rebalance abilities, refresh event modes, and introduce limited-time NBA Heroes codes.
